title.zh: 卷二十六 本紀第二十六: 道宗六
title.raw: 卷二十六 本紀第二十六: 道宗六 Volume 26 Annals 26: Daozong 6

sentences.zh: 道宗六

translations.literal: Daozong, Part Six
translations.idiomatic: Daozong, Part Six

sentences.zh: 壽隆元年春正月己亥，如混同江。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shoulong, spring, first month, on jihai day, went to Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shoulong, on jihai day of the first spring month the court went to Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，西南面招討司奏拔思母來侵，蕭阿魯帶等擊破之。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Southwest Route pacification office memorialized that Basimu had come to invade; Xiao Arudai and others defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Southwest Route pacification office memorialized that Basimu had come to invade; Xiao Arudai and others defeated them.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，振奉聖州貧民。

translations.literal: On yimao day relieved poor people in Fengsheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day poor people in Fengsheng Prefecture were relieved.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，賜左、右二皮室貧民錢。

translations.literal: Second month, on wuchen day, money was bestowed on poor people of the Left and Right Two Pishi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day of the second month money was bestowed on poor people of the Left and Right Two Pishi.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，高麗遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，駐蹕魚兒濼。

translations.literal: On yihai day halted at Yuer Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the court halted at Yuer Marsh.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，賜東北路貧民絹。

translations.literal: Third month, on bingwu day, silk was bestowed on poor people of the Northeast Route.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day of the third month silk was bestowed on poor people of the Northeast Route.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，斡特剌奏討耶睹刮捷。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on dingmao day Wotela memorialized victory over Yedigua.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day of the fourth summer month Wotela memorialized victory over Yedigua.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，女直遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On yihai day Jurchen dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，錄西北路有功將士。

translations.literal: On gengyin day meritorious officers of the Northwest Route were recorded.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day meritorious officers of the Northwest Route were recorded.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未朔，左夷離畢耶律吐朵為惕隱，南京宣徽使耶律特末為北院大王。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on yiwei new moon, Left yilibi Yelü Tuduo was made tiyin; Nanjing commissioner of the palace Yelü Temuo was made Northern Court great king.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei new moon of the fifth month Left yilibi Yelü Tuduo was made tiyin; Nanjing commissioner of the palace Yelü Temuo was made Northern Court great king.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，贈陣亡者官。

translations.literal: On guimao day office was posthumously granted to those killed in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day office was posthumously granted to those killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，駐蹕特禮嶺。

translations.literal: On dingsi day halted at Teli Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the court halted at Teli Ridge.

sentences.zh: 六月己巳，以知奚六部大王事回裏不為本部大王，權參知政事趙孝嚴為漢人行宮都部署，圍場都管撒八以討阻卜功，加鎮國大將軍。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jisi day, because he administered Xi Six Divisions great king affairs Huilibu was made great king of that division; acting associate administrator of affairs Zhao Xiaoyan was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; hunting-grounds director Saba, for merit against Zubu, was promoted Defender of the State grand general.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day of the sixth month, because he administered Xi Six Divisions great king affairs Huilibu was made great king of that division; acting associate administrator of affairs Zhao Xiaoyan was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; hunting-grounds director Saba, for merit against Zubu, was promoted Defender of the State grand general.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，阻卜長禿裏底及圖木葛來貢。

translations.literal: On guisi day Zubu chief Tuliudi and Tumuge came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Zubu chief Tuliudi and Tumuge came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子，阻卜長猛達斯等來貢。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on gengzi day Zubu chief Mengdasi and others came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day of the seventh autumn month Zubu chief Mengdasi and others came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，獵沙嶺。

translations.literal: On guichou day hunted at Sha Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the court hunted at Sha Ridge.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，頗里八部來附，進方物。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the eight divisions of Poli came to submit and presented local goods.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the eight divisions of Poli came to submit and presented local goods.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，斡特剌奏磨古斯捷。

translations.literal: On yimao day Wotela memorialized victory over Mogusi.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Wotela memorialized victory over Mogusi.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，祠木葉山。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jiayin day sacrificed at Muye Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day of the ninth month sacrifice was made at Muye Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔西京炮人、弩人教西北路漢軍。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, edict ordered Western Capital artillerymen and crossbowmen to train Northwest Route Han troops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict ordered Western Capital artillerymen and crossbowmen to train Northwest Route Han troops.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，駐蹕藕絲淀。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiazi day halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以北面林牙耶律大悲奴為右夷離畢。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Northern Court palace academician Yelü Dabeinu was made Right yilibi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Northern Court palace academician Yelü Dabeinu was made Right yilibi.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以參知政事王師儒為樞密副使，漢人行宮都部署趙孝嚴參知政事。

translations.literal: On guiwei day associate administrator of affairs Wang Shiru was made associate privy commissioner; Khitan mobile palace deployment director Zhao Xiaoyan associate administrator of affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day associate administrator of affairs Wang Shiru was made associate privy commissioner; Khitan mobile palace deployment director Zhao Xiaoyan associate administrator of affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，錄討阻卜有功將士。

translations.literal: On renchen day meritorious officers against Zubu were recorded.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day meritorious officers against Zubu were recorded.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，女直遣使進馬。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on bingshen day Jurchen dispatched envoys presenting horses.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day of the eleventh month Jurchen sent envoys presenting horses.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以都統斡特剌為西北路招討使，封漆水郡王。

translations.literal: On jihai day supreme commander Wotela was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner and enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day supreme commander Wotela was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner and enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，夏國進貝多葉佛經。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Xia State presented palm-leaf Buddhist scriptures.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Xia State presented palm-leaf Buddhist scriptures.

sentences.zh: 庚申，高麗王昱疾，命其叔颙權知國事。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Goryeo king Yun fell ill; his uncle Yong was ordered to administer state affairs provisionally.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Goryeo king Yun fell ill; his uncle Yong was ordered to administer state affairs provisionally.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥朔，以知北院樞密使事耶律阿思為北院樞密使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on guihai new moon, because he administered Northern Court privy affairs Yelü Asi was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai new moon of the twelfth month, because he administered Northern Court privy affairs Yelü Asi was made Northern Court privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是年，放進士陳衡甫等百三十人。

translations.literal: That year advanced scholars Chen Hengfu and one hundred thirty others were released.
translations.idiomatic: That year advanced scholars Chen Hengfu and one hundred thirty others were released.

sentences.zh: 二年[1]春正月甲午，如春水。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on jiawu day, went to spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on jiawu day of the first spring month the court went to spring waters.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，西南面招討司討拔思母，破之。

translations.literal: On guimao day Southwest Route pacification office attacked Basimu and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Southwest Route pacification office attacked Basimu and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，駐蹕瑟尼思。

translations.literal: On yimao day halted at Senisi.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the court halted at Senisi.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，市牛給烏古、敵烈、隈烏古部貧民。

translations.literal: On xinyou day cattle were purchased and given to poor people of Wugu, Dilie, and Weiwugu tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day cattle were purchased and given to poor people of Wugu, Dilie, and Weiwugu tribes.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，振達麻裏別古部。

translations.literal: Second month, on guihai day Damaolibiegu tribe was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day of the second month Damaolibiegu tribe was relieved.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，振西北邊軍。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jimao day northwest border armies were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day of the fourth summer month northwest border armies were relieved.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，駐蹕撒裏乃。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on xinyou day halted at Salinai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day of the sixth month the court halted at Salinai.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲午，阻卜來貢。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiawu day Zubu came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day of the seventh autumn month Zubu came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙午，獵赤山。

translations.literal: On bingwu day hunted at Red Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the court hunted at Red Mountain.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，頗裏八部進馬。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on yichou day eight divisions of Poli presented horses.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day of the eighth month eight divisions of Poli presented horses.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，徙烏古敵烈部於烏納水，以扼北邊之沖。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on bingwu day Wugu and Dilie tribes were moved to Wuna River to block the northern frontier pass.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day of the ninth month Wugu and Dilie tribes were moved to Wuna River to block the northern frontier pass.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，駐蹕藕絲淀。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuchen day halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，高麗遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，斡特剌討梅裏急，破之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiwei day Wotela attacked Meiliji and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day of the twelfth month Wotela attacked Meiliji and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，南府宰相耶律鐸魯斡致仕。

translations.literal: On renxu day Southern Court chancellor Yelü Teluwo retired.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Southern Court chancellor Yelü Teluwo retired.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，蕭撻不也為北府宰相，耶律大悲奴殿前都點檢。

translations.literal: On guihai day Xiao Tabuye was made Southern Court chancellor; Yelü Dabeinu hall front inspector-general.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Xiao Tabuye was made Southern Court chancellor; Yelü Dabeinu hall front inspector-general.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，夏國獻宋俘。

translations.literal: On yihai day Xia State presented Song captives.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Xia State presented Song captives.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丁亥，如春水。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on dinghai day, went to spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on dinghai day of the first spring month the court went to spring waters.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，烏古部節度使耶律陳家奴以功加尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On renyin day Wugu tribal military commissioner Yelü Chenjianu, for merit, was promoted Minister of the Right.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Wugu tribal military commissioner Yelü Chenjianu, for merit, was promoted Minister of the Right.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，駐蹕雙山。

translations.literal: On guimao day halted at Twin Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the court halted at Twin Mountains.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰朔，南京水，遣使振之。

translations.literal: Second month, on bingchen new moon, Nanjing had flood; envoys were dispatched to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the second month Nanjing had flood; envoys were dispatched to relieve it.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙午，阻卜長猛撒葛、粘八葛長禿骨撒、梅裏急長忽魯八等請復舊地，貢方物，從之。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, on bingwu day Zubu chief Mengsage, Nianbage chief Tugusa, Meiliji chief Huluba, and others requested restoration of former lands, presented local goods, and it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day of the intercalary third month Zubu chief Mengsage, Nianbage chief Tugusa, Meiliji chief Huluba, and others requested restoration of former lands, presented local goods, and it was granted.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，燕國王延禧生子。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinyou day Prince of Yan Yanxi had a son.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day of the third month Prince of Yan Yanxi had a son.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賜名撻魯。

translations.literal: On guihai day the name Talu was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the name Talu was bestowed.

sentences.zh: 妃之父長哥遷左監門衛上將軍，仍賜官屬錢。

translations.literal: The consort's father Changge was transferred Left Defender of the Gate grand general and still bestowed money for his staff.
translations.idiomatic: The consort's father Changge was transferred Left Defender of the Gate grand general and still bestowed money for his staff.

sentences.zh: 是春，高麗王昱薨。

translations.literal: That spring Goryeo king Yun died.
translations.idiomatic: That spring Goryeo king Yun died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，南府宰相趙廷睦出知興中府事，參知政事牛溫舒兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, Southern Court chancellor Zhao Tingmu went out to administer Xingzhong Prefecture; associate administrator of affairs Niu Wenshu also associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Southern Court chancellor Zhao Tingmu went out to administer Xingzhong Prefecture; associate administrator of affairs Niu Wenshu also associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，斡特剌討阻卜，破之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on guihai day Wotela attacked Zubu and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day of the fifth month Wotela attacked Zubu and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 己巳，駐蹕撒裏乃。

translations.literal: On jisi day halted at Salinai.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the court halted at Salinai.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，詔罷諸路馳驲貢新。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiashen day, edict abolished presenting fresh goods by relay post in all routes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day of the sixth month an edict abolished presenting fresh goods by relay post in all routes.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔每冬駐蹕之所，宰相以下構宅，毋役其民。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, edict ordered that wherever the court halted each winter, chancellors and below should build residences without levying corvée on the people.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day an edict ordered that wherever the court halted each winter, chancellors and below should build residences without levying corvée on the people.

sentences.zh: 辛丑丑，夏人來告宋城要地，遣使之宋，諭與夏和。

translations.literal: On xinchou day Xia people came to report that Song had seized strategic places; envoys were sent to Song to advise harmony with Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Xia people came to report that Song had seized strategic places; envoys were sent to Song to advise harmony with Xia.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以契丹行宮都部署耶律吾也為南院大王。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Wuye was made Southern Court great king.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Wuye was made Southern Court great king.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子朔，獵黑嶺。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renzi new moon, hunted at Black Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Black Ridge.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，蒲盧毛朵部長率其民來歸。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jihai day Puloumaoduo tribal chief led his people to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day of the eighth month Puloumaoduo tribal chief led his people to submit.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，彗星見西方。

translations.literal: On yisi day a comet appeared in the west.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day a comet appeared in the west.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，駐蹕藕絲淀。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renshen day halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以武定軍節度使梁援為漢人行宮都部署。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Wuding Army military commissioner Liang Yuan was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Wuding Army military commissioner Liang Yuan was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，斡特剌奏討梅裏急捷。

translations.literal: On wuyin day Wotela memorialized victory over Meiliji.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Wotela memorialized victory over Meiliji.

sentences.zh: 己卯，五國部長來貢。

translations.literal: On jimao day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚戌，以西北路招討使斡特剌為南府宰相。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengxu day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Wotela was made Southern Court chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day of the tenth winter month Northwest Route pacification commissioner Wotela was made Southern Court chancellor.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，蒲盧毛朵部來貢。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yimao day Puloumaoduo tribe came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day of the eleventh month Puloumaoduo tribe came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以安車召醫巫閭山僧誌達。

translations.literal: On wuwu day a carriage was sent to summon Yiwulü Mountain monk Zhida.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day a carriage was sent to summon Yiwulü Mountain monk Zhida.

sentences.zh: 己未，以中京留守韓資讓知樞密院事，同知南院樞密使事蕭藥師奴知右夷離畢。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Central Capital regent Han Zirang was made administrator of Privy Council affairs; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Yaoshinu administrator of Right yilibi affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Central Capital regent Han Zirang was made administrator of Privy Council affairs; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Yaoshinu administrator of Right yilibi affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，西北路統軍司奏討梅裏急捷。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Northwest Route supreme commander's office memorialized victory over Meiliji.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Northwest Route supreme commander's office memorialized victory over Meiliji.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月壬子，如魚兒濼。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on renzi day, went to Yuer Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on renzi day of the first spring month the court went to Yuer Marsh.

sentences.zh: 己巳，徙阻卜等貧民於山前。

translations.literal: On jisi day poor people among Zubu and others were moved south of the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day poor people among Zubu and others were moved south of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 辛未，宋遣使來饋錦綺。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Song dispatched envoys presenting brocade and silk.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Song sent envoys presenting brocade and silk.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，幸春州。

translations.literal: Third month, on gengwu day visited Chun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day of the third month the court visited Chun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙子，有司奏黃河清。

translations.literal: On bingzi day relevant offices memorialized that the Yellow River had cleared.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day relevant offices memorialized that the Yellow River had cleared.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，以雨，罷獵。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinchou day, because of rain, hunting was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day of the fourth summer month, because of rain, hunting was stopped.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，那也奏北邊捷。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on guiyou day Na Ye memorialized victory on the northern border.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day of the fifth month Na Ye memorialized victory on the northern border.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，駐蹕撒裏乃。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day halted at Salinai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the court halted at Salinai.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅朔，夏國為宋所攻，遣使求援。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on wuyin new moon, Xia State was attacked by Song and dispatched envoys seeking aid.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin new moon of the sixth month Xia State was attacked by Song and sent envoys seeking aid.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以遼興軍節度使涅裏為惕隱，前知惕隱事耶律郭三為南京統軍使。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Nieli was made tiyin; former acting tiyin Yelü Guosan Nanjing supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Nieli was made tiyin; former acting tiyin Yelü Guosan Nanjing supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以參知政事牛溫舒兼知中京留守事。

translations.literal: On jiawu day associate administrator of affairs Niu Wenshu also administered Central Capital regency.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day associate administrator of affairs Niu Wenshu also administered Central Capital regency.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，如黑嶺。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuwu day, went to Black Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day of the seventh autumn month the court went to Black Ridge.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥朔，駐蹕藕絲淀。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yihai new moon, halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai new moon of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以南府宰相斡特剌兼契丹行宮都部署，以傅導燕國王延禧。

translations.literal: On jimao day Southern Court chancellor Wotela also Khitan mobile palace deployment director, to tutor Prince of Yan Yanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Southern Court chancellor Wotela was also made Khitan mobile palace deployment director, to tutor Prince of Yan Yanxi.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳朔，知右夷離畢事蕭藥師奴、樞密直學士耶律儼使宋，諷與夏和。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yisi new moon, administrator of Right yilibi affairs Xiao Yaoshinu and privy council academician Yelü Yan were sent to Song to advise harmony with Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi new moon of the eleventh month administrator of Right yilibi affairs Xiao Yaoshinu and privy council academician Yelü Yan were sent to Song to advise harmony with Xia.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，夏復遣使求援。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Xia again dispatched envoys seeking aid.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Xia again sent envoys seeking aid.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，為燕國王延禧行再生禮，曲赦三百里內囚。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on renchen day performed the rebirth ritual for Prince of Yan Yanxi; partial amnesty for prisoners within three hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day of the twelfth month the rebirth ritual was performed for Prince of Yan Yanxi; partial amnesty for prisoners within three hundred li.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月乙巳，如魚兒濼。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on yimao day, went to Yuer Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on yimao day of the first spring month the court went to Yuer Marsh.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔夏國王李乾順伐拔思母等部。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, edict ordered Xia State king Li Qianshun to attack Basimu and other tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict ordered Xia State king Li Qianshun to attack Basimu and other tribes.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬戌，藥師奴等使宋回，奏宋罷兵。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, on renxu day Yaoshinu and others returned from Song and memorialized that Song had ceased hostilities.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day of the fifth summer month Yaoshinu and others returned from Song and memorialized that Song had ceased hostilities.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，謁乾陵。

translations.literal: On guihai day visited Qian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the court visited Qian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以南府宰相斡特剌兼西北路招討使，禁軍都統。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Southern Court chancellor Wotela also Northwest Route pacification commissioner and forbidden-army supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Southern Court chancellor Wotela was also made Northwest Route pacification commissioner and forbidden-army supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 己巳，駐蹕沿柳湖。

translations.literal: On jisi day halted at Yanliu Lake.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the court halted at Yanliu Lake.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，以奚六部大王回離保為契丹行宮都部署，知右夷離畢事蕭藥師奴南面林牙，兼知契丹行宮都部署事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiashen day Xi Six Divisions great king Huilibao was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; administrator of Right yilibi affairs Xiao Yaoshinu Southern Court palace academician and also administrator of Khitan mobile palace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day of the sixth month Xi Six Divisions great king Huilibao was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; administrator of Right yilibi affairs Xiao Yaoshinu Southern Court palace academician and also administrator of Khitan mobile palace affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙未，五國部長來朝。

translations.literal: On yiwei day chieftains of the Five States came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day chieftains of the Five States came to court.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，阻卜來貢。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Zubu came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Zubu came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以興聖宮使耶律郝家奴為右夷離畢。

translations.literal: On jihai day commissioner of Xing Sheng Palace Yelü Haojianu was made Right yilibi.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day commissioner of Xing Sheng Palace Yelü Haojianu was made Right yilibi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅朔，惕德長禿的等來貢。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renyin new moon, Tiede chief Tude and others came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the seventh autumn month Tiede chief Tude and others came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，如大牢古山。

translations.literal: On xinhai day went to Dalaogu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the court went to Dalaogu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 閏九月丙子，駐蹕獨盧金。

translations.literal: Intercalary ninth month, on bingzi day halted at Dulu Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day of the intercalary ninth month the court halted at Dulu Marsh.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥朔，高麗王颙遣使乞封冊。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jihai new moon, Goryeo king Yong dispatched envoys requesting investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai new moon of the tenth winter month Goryeo king Yong sent envoys requesting investiture.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，斡特剌奏討耶睹刮捷。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Wotela memorialized victory over Yedigua.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Wotela memorialized victory over Yedigua.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以同知南京留守事蕭得裏底知北院樞密使事。

translations.literal: On bingyin day associate regent of Nanjing Xiao Delidi was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day associate regent of Nanjing Xiao Delidi was made Northern Court privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，宋遣郭知章、曹平來聘。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Song dispatched Guo Zhizhang and Cao Ping on a friendly visit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Song sent Guo Zhizhang and Cao Ping on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 戌辰，振遼州饑，仍免租賦一年。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Liaozhou famine was relieved; rent and tax were also remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Liaozhou famine was relieved; rent and tax were also remitted for one year.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，振南、北二糺。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiaxu day Southern and Northern Two Jiu were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the eleventh month Southern and Northern Two Jiu were relieved.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，夏國以宋罷兵，遣使來謝。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, because Song had ceased hostilities, Xia State dispatched envoys to give thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, because Song had ceased hostilities, Xia State sent envoys to give thanks.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，以參知政事趙孝嚴為漢人行宮都部署，漢人行宮都部署梁援為遼興軍節度使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiazi day associate administrator of affairs Zhao Xiaoyan was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; Khitan mobile palace deployment director Liang Yuan Liaoxing Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the twelfth month associate administrator of affairs Zhao Xiaoyan was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; Khitan mobile palace deployment director Liang Yuan Liaoxing Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月癸酉，南院大王耶律吾也薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on guiyou day Southern Court great king Yelü Wuye died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on guiyou day of the first spring month Southern Court great king Yelü Wuye died.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以太師致仕禿開起為奚六部大王。

translations.literal: On renwu day retired grand preceptor Tukaiqi was made Xi Six Divisions great king.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day retired grand preceptor Tukaiqi was made Xi Six Divisions great king.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，如春水。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, went to spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the court went to spring waters.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，斡特剌執磨古斯來獻。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Wotela brought Mogusi in captivity to present.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Wotela brought Mogusi in captivity to present.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔問民疾苦。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, edict inquired into the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict inquired into the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，以烏古部節度使陳家奴為南院大王。

translations.literal: Second month, on dingwei day Wugu tribal military commissioner Chenjianu was made Southern Court great king.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day of the second month Wugu tribal military commissioner Chenjianu was made Southern Court great king.

sentences.zh: 己酉，磔磨古斯於市。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Mogusi was dismembered at the market.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Mogusi was dismembered at the market.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，出絹賜五院貧民。

translations.literal: On guichou day silk was issued to bestow on poor people of the Five Divisions.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day silk was issued to bestow on poor people of the Five Divisions.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，宋遣使告宋主煦殂，弟佶嗣位，即日遣使吊祭。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Song dispatched envoys announcing the late emperor Xu had died and his younger brother Ji had succeeded; envoys were immediately sent to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Song sent envoys announcing the late emperor Xu had died and his younger brother Ji had succeeded; envoys were immediately sent to offer condolences.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，馳朔州山林之禁。

translations.literal: Third month, on jiashen day the ban on hunting in Shuozhou forests was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day of the third month the ban on hunting in Shuozhou forests was lifted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on dingyou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou new moon of the fourth summer month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，如炭山。

translations.literal: On guimao day went to Coal Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the court went to Coal Mountain.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，烏古部討茶紥剌，破之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on renwu day Wugu tribe attacked Chazhala and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day of the fifth month Wugu tribe attacked Chazhala and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，漢人行宮都部署趙孝嚴薨。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Zhao Xiaoyan died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Zhao Xiaoyan died.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，駐蹕納葛濼。

translations.literal: On bingxu day halted at Nage Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the court halted at Nage Marsh.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，宋遣使饋先帝遺物。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Song dispatched envoys presenting the late emperor's belongings.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Song sent envoys presenting the late emperor's belongings.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以東京留守何魯掃古為惕隱，南院宣徽使蕭常哥為漢人行宮都部署。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Eastern Capital regent Helu Saogu was made tiyin; Southern Court commissioner of the palace Xiao Changge Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Eastern Capital regent Helu Saogu was made tiyin; Southern Court commissioner of the palace Xiao Changge Khitan mobile palace deployment director.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，遣使賀宋主。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on gengzi day envoys were dispatched to congratulate the Song emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day of the sixth month envoys were dispatched to congratulate the Song emperor.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以有司案牘書宋帝「嗣位」為「登寶位」，詔奪宰相鄭顓以下官，出顓知興中府事，韓資讓為崇義軍節度使，御史中丞韓君義為廣順軍節度使。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, because relevant offices had written in documents that the Song emperor had "succeeded to the throne" rather than "ascended the precious throne," edict stripped office from chancellor Zheng Zhuan and those below; Zhuan was sent out to administer Xingzhong Prefecture, Han Zirang made Chongyi Army military commissioner, censor-in-chief Han Junyi Guangshun Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, because relevant offices had written in documents that the Song emperor had "succeeded to the throne" rather than "ascended the precious throne," an edict stripped office from chancellor Zheng Zhuan and those below; Zhuan was sent out to administer Xingzhong Prefecture, Han Zirang made Chongyi Army military commissioner, censor-in-chief Han Junyi Guangshun Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，阻卜長來貢。

translations.literal: On guichou day Zubu chiefs came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Zubu chiefs came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊午，遣使決五京滯獄。

translations.literal: On wuwu day envoys were dispatched to decide stalled cases in the Five Capitals.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day envoys were dispatched to decide stalled cases in the Five Capitals.

sentences.zh: 己未，以遼興軍節度使梁援為樞密副使。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Liang Yuan was made associate privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Liang Yuan was made associate privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，如沙嶺。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on gengwu day, went to Sha Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day of the seventh autumn month the court went to Sha Ridge.

sentences.zh: 壬申，耶睹刮諸部寇西北路。

translations.literal: On renshen day Yedigua and other tribes raided the Northwest Route.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Yedigua and other tribes raided the Northwest Route.

sentences.zh: 八月，斡特剌以兵擊敗之，使來獻捷。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Wotela with troops defeated them and sent envoys presenting victory.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Wotela with troops defeated them and sent envoys presenting victory.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，望祠木葉山。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on guiwei day gazed-sacrificed at Muye Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day of the ninth month gazed-sacrifice was made at Muye Mountain.

sentences.zh: 戊子，駐蹕藕絲淀。

translations.literal: On wuzi day halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，以樞密副使王師儒監修國史。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on renyin day associate privy commissioner Wang Shiru supervised compilation of the national history.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day of the tenth winter month associate privy commissioner Wang Shiru supervised compilation of the national history.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，五國諸部長來貢。

translations.literal: On guimao day chieftains of the Five States and various tribes came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day chieftains of the Five States and various tribes came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以平州饑，復其租賦一年。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, because Ping Prefecture had famine, its rent and tax were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, because Ping Prefecture had famine, its rent and tax were remitted for one year.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，以天德軍民田世榮三世同居，詔官之，令一子三班院祗候。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on renshen day, because Tianshun Army commoner Tian Shirong's family had lived together three generations, edict granted him office and ordered one son attendant in the Third-Rank Court.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day of the eleventh month, because Tianshun Army commoner Tian Shirong's family had lived together three generations, an edict granted him office and ordered one son attendant in the Third-Rank Court.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔醫巫閭山僧誌達設壇於內殿。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, edict ordered Yiwulü Mountain monk Zhida to set up an altar in the inner hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day an edict ordered Yiwulü Mountain monk Zhida to set up an altar in the inner hall.

sentences.zh: 戊子，夏國王李乾順遣使請尚公主。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Xia State king Li Qianshun dispatched envoys requesting marriage to an imperial princess.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Xia State king Li Qianshun sent envoys requesting marriage to an imperial princess.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，女直遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on yiwei day Jurchen dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day of the twelfth month Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以知右夷離畢事郝家奴為北面林牙。

translations.literal: On jihai day administrator of Right yilibi affairs Haojianu was made Northern Court palace academician.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day administrator of Right yilibi affairs Haojianu was made Northern Court palace academician.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔燕國王延禧擬註大將軍以下官。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, edict ordered Prince of Yan Yanxi to nominate officers from grand general downward.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day an edict ordered Prince of Yan Yanxi to nominate officers from grand general downward.

sentences.zh: 庚申，鐵驪來貢。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Tieli came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Tieli came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 宋遣使來謝。

translations.literal: Song dispatched envoys to give thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Song sent envoys to give thanks.

sentences.zh: 帝不豫。

translations.literal: The emperor fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 是歲，封高麗王颙長子俁為三韓國公。

translations.literal: That year Goryeo king Yong's eldest son Hou was enfeoffed Duke of Three Han States.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goryeo king Yong's eldest son Hou was enfeoffed Duke of Three Han States.

sentences.zh: 放進士康秉儉等八十七人。

translations.literal: Advanced scholars Kang Bingjian and eighty-seven others were released.
translations.idiomatic: Advanced scholars Kang Bingjian and eighty-seven others were released.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月壬戌朔，力疾禦清風殿受百官及諸國使賀。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on renxu new moon, though gravely ill received congratulations from officials and envoys of all states at Qingfeng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the renxu new moon of the first spring month, though gravely ill the emperor received congratulations from officials and envoys of all states at Qingfeng Hall.

sentences.zh: 是夜，白氣如練，自天而降。

translations.literal: That night white vapor like silk descended from heaven.
translations.idiomatic: That night white vapor like silk descended from heaven.

sentences.zh: 黑雲起於西北，疾飛有聲。

translations.literal: Black clouds rose in the northwest and flew swiftly with sound.
translations.idiomatic: Black clouds rose in the northwest and flew swiftly with sound.

sentences.zh: 北有青赤黑白氣，相雜而落。

translations.literal: To the north green, red, black, and white vapors mixed and fell.
translations.idiomatic: To the north green, red, black, and white vapors mixed and fell.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，如混同江。

translations.literal: On guihai day went to Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the court went to Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上崩於行宮，年七十。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the emperor died at the mobile palace, age seventy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the emperor died at the mobile palace, age seventy.

sentences.zh: 遺詔燕國王延禧嗣位。

translations.literal: His testamentary edict ordered Prince of Yan Yanxi to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: His testamentary edict ordered Prince of Yan Yanxi to succeed.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，上尊謚仁聖大孝文皇帝，廟號道宗。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on gengzi day posthumous title Benevolent Sage Great Filial Literary Emperor; temple name Daozong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day of the sixth month posthumous title Benevolent Sage Great Filial Literary Emperor; temple name Daozong.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：道宗初即位，求直言，訪治道，勸農興學，救災恤患，粲然可觀。

translations.literal: Appraisal: When Daozong first took the throne he sought frank speech, inquired about governance, encouraged agriculture and learning, relieved disasters and cared for the afflicted — splendid to behold.
translations.idiomatic: Appraisal: When Daozong first took the throne he sought frank speech, inquired about governance, encouraged agriculture and learning, relieved disasters and cared for the afflicted — splendid to behold.

sentences.zh: 及夫謗訕之令既行，告訐之賞日重。

translations.literal: But when the law on slander was enforced, rewards for informing increased daily.
translations.idiomatic: But when the law on slander was enforced, rewards for informing increased daily.

sentences.zh: 群邪並興，讒巧競進。

translations.literal: Wicked men arose together; slander and flattery vied to advance.
translations.idiomatic: Wicked men arose together; slander and flattery vied to advance.

sentences.zh: 賊及骨肉，皇基浸危。

translations.literal: Harm reached even his kin; the imperial foundation gradually grew perilous.
translations.idiomatic: Harm reached even his kin; the imperial foundation gradually grew perilous.

sentences.zh: 眾正淪胥，諸部反側，甲兵之用，無寧歲矣。

translations.literal: Worthies were ruined; all tribes grew restive; use of arms knew no year of peace.
translations.idiomatic: Worthies were ruined; all tribes grew restive; use of arms knew no year of peace.

sentences.zh: 一歲而飯僧三十六萬，一日而祝髮三千。

translations.literal: In one year he fed thirty-six thousand monks; in one day three thousand took tonsure.
translations.idiomatic: In one year he fed thirty-six thousand monks; in one day three thousand took tonsure.

sentences.zh: 徒勤小惠，蔑計大本，尚足與論治哉？

translations.literal: He toiled at petty kindness yet scorned the great foundation — hardly fit to discuss good governance?
translations.idiomatic: He toiled at petty kindness yet scorned the great foundation — hardly fit to discuss good governance?
